anchor.semantic_hook: A nearly complete circle makes almost the whole visible, with only one narrow piece absent.
anchor.setting: A circular multipurpose hall contains a floor-level ring divided into many equal bays, every bay but one filled with relevant objects. Conference furniture, display tables, and broad windows overlooking the sea surround the ring. One impossible missing wedge of the ring floats directly above its empty slot, forever short of completing the whole.
